summary: A2Z Cust2Mate Solutions Corp., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K dated November 12, 2026, incorporating its unaudited condensed interim financial statements and MD&A for the three and nine months ended September 30, 2026, plus CEO and CFO interim certifications and XBRL exhibits. This is a routine quarterly reporting package, not a special situation. The filing references Hedia acquisition balances and a Bank Hapoalim facility within the financial statements but discloses no new transaction, price, stake or board recommendation. No deal terms or risk-arb angle apply.
